title: Login Issue
description: The customer reported that they are unable to log into the system even after entering the correct username and password. They tried multiple times and also attempted from different browsers and devices, but the issue still persists. This problem is affecting their daily workflow and preventing them from accessing important features. Immediate investigation is required to verify authentication services, server response, and possible account lock mechanisms.

title: Payment Failure
description: The customer experienced a payment failure while attempting to complete a transaction using a credit card. Although the card was valid and had sufficient balance, the transaction was declined without a clear error message. This has caused confusion and frustration for the customer. The issue may be related to payment gateway integration, timeout problems, or bank verification errors.

title: UI Bug
description: A visual issue has been reported on the dashboard where buttons are not properly aligned on certain screen sizes. The layout appears broken especially on smaller laptops and tablets. Although the functionality works correctly, the poor alignment affects user experience and professional appearance. The frontend layout and responsive CSS rules should be reviewed and corrected.

title: Email Not Sent
description: The customer did not receive the order confirmation email after successfully placing an order. They checked spam and promotion folders but found nothing. This issue may reduce customer trust and cause uncertainty about order completion. The email service configuration, SMTP logs, and email queue processing system need to be reviewed carefully.

title: Slow Performance
description: The website is taking an unusually long time to load pages, especially during peak usage hours. Customers reported delays when navigating between pages and submitting forms. This performance issue negatively impacts user satisfaction and may increase bounce rate. Possible causes include server overload, unoptimized images, heavy scripts, or database query delays.

title: Mobile App Crash
description: The mobile application crashes immediately after launch on several Android devices. Users are unable to reach the login screen and the app closes automatically. This issue prevents any usage of the mobile platform. Crash logs and recent app updates should be analyzed to identify compatibility or memory-related problems.

title: Password Reset
description: The password reset link sent to the user's email is not functioning correctly. When clicking the link, it either shows an expired message or redirects to an invalid page. This prevents users from regaining account access. Token expiration logic and reset URL configuration should be carefully tested and fixed.

title: Search Error
description: Users reported that the search feature is not displaying accurate or complete results. Some relevant data does not appear even when correct keywords are used. This problem reduces usability and makes information difficult to find. The backend search query logic and indexing mechanism should be reviewed.

title: Data Sync Issue
description: The customer noticed that data updates made on one device are not appearing on another device. This inconsistency causes confusion and risk of outdated information. The issue may involve API synchronization delays, caching problems, or background sync failures that must be investigated immediately.

title: Notification Delay
description: Push notifications are being delivered several minutes late instead of instantly. This affects time-sensitive alerts and reduces effectiveness of the notification system. The issue may be related to server queue delays, background job scheduling, or third-party notification services configuration.

title: Broken Link
description: The help page link on the website leads to a broken or missing page. Users are unable to access support documentation when needed. This reduces overall usability and creates frustration. The routing configuration and deployment paths should be verified and corrected promptly.

title: Invoice Error
description: The invoice generated after purchase shows an incorrect total amount that does not match the actual payment. This creates confusion and may cause trust issues with customers. The tax calculation and discount logic should be reviewed thoroughly to ensure financial accuracy.

title: Profile Update Issue
description: The user attempted to update their profile information, but changes were not saved successfully. After refreshing the page, old data reappeared. This issue may be related to API failure or validation errors. The profile update endpoint and form handling logic require investigation.

title: File Upload Error
description: Users are unable to upload documents through the file upload feature. The system displays an error after selecting the file. This affects document submission workflows. File size limits, server permissions, and upload API responses should be checked carefully.

title: Logout Problem
description: Some users reported that clicking the logout button does not properly end the session. After refreshing the page, the account remains logged in. This may pose security risks. Session handling, token invalidation, and cookie management logic must be reviewed immediately.
